explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 1074 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows fluconazole has been in shortage since 2022-01-13, and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on the list for 57 months.

The label for our product (NDC 51407042430) names Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. as the labeler and relabel/repack plant (FEI 3006458969) and Novitium Pharma LLC as the manufacturing plant (FEI 3012541241).

FDA inspected Novitium Pharma LLC (FEI 3012541241) and classified the inspection VAI on 2019-02-04, with the classification letter dated 2019-04-03 — 1074 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2022-01-13.
FDA inspected Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. (FEI 3006458969) multiple times, including an OAI classification on 2011-02-02 and a Warning Letter on 2011-04-26.
The most recent inspections for both plants were classified NAI: Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. on 2025-06-11 and Novitium Pharma LLC on 2024-02-16.
Corvale East has 13 days on hand (164 units at 12.8/day) and Corvale General has 18 days on hand (289 units at 16.4/day).
The rule-based best option is to buy from A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-fd327c.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%fluconazole%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%fluconazole%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-42d93b.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('c2c7242d-d172-4733-e053-2995a90acb2e') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-d77c86.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%fluconazole%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-ac0497.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%fluconazole%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-d52b6c.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%fluconazole%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-bb303f.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3006458969', '3012541241') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-e3ad47.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3006458969', '3012541241') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-580905.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3006458969', '3012541241') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('golden state medical supply', 'novitium')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-337a82.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('golden state medical supply', 'novitium') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%fluconazole%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-fdaf2c.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('707152') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-366c39.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('51407042430')

Q-3bd017.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%fluconazole%'
